title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Rate Card: Passes, Visit Prices and Validity
content:
**Tailwise Grooming Salon — rate card for prepaid passes and Groom Club Monthly.** The figures below are the list figures for every pass in the range. A pass is priced by the pet's size class (toy, small, medium, large, giant); for Groom Club Monthly the "pass price" is the monthly fee, the visits are credited per billing month and the validity is the billing period.

### Visits, validity and who may be serviced

| Pass | Visits credited | Validity | Species | Youngest age |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 3 | 6 calendar months | dogs | 16 weeks |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 4 | 12 calendar months | dogs, cats | 16 weeks |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 4 | 12 calendar months | dogs, cats | 16 weeks |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 6 | 12 calendar months | dogs, cats | 16 weeks |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 6 | 12 calendar months | dogs | 20 weeks |
| Groom Club Monthly | 1 per billing month | 1 calendar month (the billing period) | dogs | 16 weeks |

The youngest age is counted in weeks from the pet's date of birth to the appointment date. The validity counts calendar months from the purchase date, after which unused visits expire.

### Pass price by size class (USD; Groom Club Monthly: monthly fee)

| Pass | Toy | Small | Medium | Large | Giant |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 86.40 | 102.60 | 129.60 | 162.00 | 199.80 |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 151.20 | 172.80 | 208.80 | 259.20 | 316.80 |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 223.20 | 252.00 | 302.40 | 352.80 | 424.80 |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 316.20 | 357.00 | 428.40 | 499.80 | 601.80 |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 418.20 | 469.20 | 550.80 | 632.40 | 754.80 |
| Groom Club Monthly | 54.99 | 61.99 | 74.99 | 87.99 | 104.99 |

### Single-visit salon price by size class (USD)

The salon price of one visit of the same service bought on its own. It is the basis the salon uses for refunds and for size differences.

| Pass | Toy | Small | Medium | Large | Giant |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 32.00 | 38.00 | 48.00 | 60.00 | 74.00 |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 42.00 | 48.00 | 58.00 | 72.00 | 88.00 |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 62.00 | 70.00 | 84.00 | 98.00 | 118.00 |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 62.00 | 70.00 | 84.00 | 98.00 | 118.00 |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 82.00 | 92.00 | 108.00 | 124.00 | 148.00 |
| Groom Club Monthly | 62.00 | 70.00 | 84.00 | 98.00 | 118.00 |

### Services performed on every visit

| Pass | Included services |
|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | bath, blow-dry, brush-out |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | bath, blow-dry, brush-out, nail trim, ear cleaning, face, feet and sanitary tidy |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | bath, blow-dry, brush-out, nail trim, ear cleaning, full haircut |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | bath, blow-dry, brush-out, nail trim, ear cleaning, full haircut |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | bath, blow-dry, brush-out, nail trim, nail grind, ear cleaning, full haircut, teeth brushing, deshedding treatment, flea and tick bath |
| Groom Club Monthly | bath, blow-dry, brush-out, nail trim, ear cleaning, full haircut |

### Reading the card (hypothetical examples)

- A medium dog on the Full Groom Pass 6-Visit: list price 428.40 for 6 visits; a single Full Groom visit for a medium dog is 84.00.
- A large dog joining Groom Club Monthly: monthly fee 87.99, one visit credited each billing month.
- A 17-week-old cat can be serviced on the Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit (16 weeks) but cats are not in the species list of the Express Bath Pass 3-Visit, the Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit or Groom Club Monthly.
